scientific_integrity: Analytical arguments establish the parameter-continuum statements; finite numerical quadrature and integration corroborate but do not certify the analytic theorem. Literature comparison is provisional, especially against older rigid-cubic sources whose full text could not be retrieved.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the exact trigonometric cubic Abel family for fixed 0<kappa<1 and sufficiently small positive epsilon, uniformly only on compact kappa ranges; the global uniqueness theorem is credited to the cited 2026 source; no classification of large perturbations, negative orbits, or arbitrary rigid cubics.
title: Symmetry-protected cycle selection and a positive half-turn defect in cubic rigid oscillators
